title: incident-bot: on-call SLO toolkit - context enrichment & quicklinks ranking
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot SLO toolkit suggestions by enriching on-call context with recent SLO breach history, correlated alerts, and prioritized runbook quicklinks. Improves relevance of suggested remediation steps and reduces mean-time-to-detect by surfacing recent related incidents.
description: Motivation: On-call engineers need concise, relevant context when SLOs degrade. Current incident-bot quicklinks return generic runbooks and SLO summaries; we want to enrich suggestions with recent breach history, correlated alerts, and a lightweight ranking so that the top quicklinks are actionable during noisy incidents. Summary: Add a context enrichment pipeline that pulls recent SLO breaches, correlates recent alerts via alert fingerprints, and scores candidate runbook quicklinks by recency, historical success (hasrun flag), and matching tags. Expose the enriched context through the existing oncall context endpoint and surface ranked quicklinks in the on-call message card. Changes included: implemented enrichment service (internal/oncall/context_enricher.go), quicklinks ranking heuristics (internal/slo/toolkit_quicklinks.go), telemetry for ranking signals (pkg/telemetry/metrics.go), UI component to display prioritized quicklinks (web/ui/quicklinks_component.tsx), small CLI wiring changes (cmd/incident-bot/main.go), and deployment manifest tweaks for a sidecar env var (deploy/k8s/incident-bot-deployment.yaml). Backward compatibility: All endpoints are additive. The enrichment is behind a feature flag INCIDENTBOT_ENABLE_SLO_ENRICHMENT (off by default). If the feature flag is disabled the behavior is unchanged. Quicklinks ranking is tolerant to missing signals. Testing: Unit tests for ranking heuristics and enrichment logic included; integration test added that simulates an SLO breach and validates top quicklinks ordering. Performed a canary rollout in staging for 48hrs with synthetic SLO violations to validate signal stability. Rollout plan: Feature-flagged rollout; enable for 10% of on-call notifications for 48hrs, monitor mean time to acknowledgment (MTTA) and quicklink click-through telemetry. If no regressions, ramp to 100% over 72hrs. Notes: Follow-up work tracked in ENG-3301 to add ML-based ranking when we have more click-through history.
